body: From the DM-189 review (orchestrator, this run): a refused pick can still leave the folder tracked (`sourceCheckoutIpc.ts:38-43`; e.g. unreadable project.json -> refused/unreadable_project but folder count 2->3, while the shared type says nothing was tracked) — fix: inspect fully before `track`, or return folder/added on that refusal, so the folder list stays fresh. A case-only rename reads as `relocated … a link or junction changed` and `relocated` maps to code project_mismatch (sourceCheckout.ts:84,237-248) — distinguish it. A compromised renderer can switch the association among tracked valid clones without a dialog by design, so the selector/preview must show the destination path explicitly.
